zephyr: perbaiki model custom yang dibaj.subject: fix(ai): custom-provider models were hijacked to another provider
zephyr: perbaiki model custom yang dibaj.body:
PROBLEM: typing a model name from another provider under the custom provider
(e.g. 'gemini-3.8-flash' through an OpenAI-compatible gateway) made Zephyr
redirect it to the Gemini provider and ask for a Gemini API key, even though
the custom gateway served that model itself. The result was a 401 or
'No API key for gemini'.

ROOT CAUSE: findModel() searched the whole catalog for the model id first,
then returned that model TOGETHER with its owning provider. The provider the
user had actually selected was ignored.

FIX: the active provider is checked first. If the model belongs to it, use it.
If the provider is freeText (custom/local), respect the model name the user
typed instead of hijacking it. Verified end to end: 'gemini-3.8-flash' through
the custom provider now goes to the custom gateway and returns a normal reply
(401 before).

zephyr: kembalikan kunci signing lama +.subject: fix(release): restore the old signing key and guard against key swaps
zephyr: kembalikan kunci signing lama +.body:
PROBLEM: the signing key was regenerated on 22 Sep (the old one was declared
broken), so v1.1.10 was signed with a key DIFFERENT from the one embedded in
v1.1.9. The Tauri updater refused it: 'The signature was created with a
different key than the one provided'. Every v1.1.9 user was unable to update
automatically and had to install by hand.

FIX
- the old key is back as the active key (the new one is backed up in
  %APPDATA%/zephyr/key-baru-20260924/)
- the pubkey in tauri.conf.json is synced back to the old key
- v1.1.10 was rebuilt and uploaded; verified cryptographically with the
  minisign-verify crate against the installer DOWNLOADED FROM GITHUB -> VALID
- the latest.json release note was rewritten in full (new features + fixes)

GUARD AGAINST A REPEAT
- scripts/cek-kunci.sh: compares the active key against a reference fingerprint
  (.kunci-terkunci) and REFUSES to release when they differ
- wired into scripts/rilis-minggu.sh before commit/push, so an automatic
  release stops before publishing if the key changed

zephyr: perbaiki performa agent, kerapat.subject: fix: agent performance, Padat density, and the command palette
zephyr: perbaiki performa agent, kerapat.body:
PERFORMANCE (reported: agent mode is very slow)
- agent history is trimmed to the last 8 steps; older tool results are cut to
  1200 chars and older assistant messages to 800, with a placeholder note.
  Measured: 363 KB -> 144 KB (60% smaller) on a 61-message history
- file_list capped at 300 entries plus an 'and N more' line
- provider timeout: recv_response 30 -> 90 seconds, per_call 12 -> 120 seconds
- agent context cache 5 -> 60 seconds

REAL BUG: palette commands changed nothing
- commandRegistry reached layoutStore through a dynamic import(), which Vite
  turns into a SEPARATE MODULE INSTANCE from the static import App.tsx uses.
  Commands changed a store the UI never read, so 'Toggle Status Bar',
  density, and other View commands looked broken. 5 call sites now use
  static imports.

DENSITY (reported: it changes nothing)
- 'Padat' now changes real metrics: tab bar 34->28px, status bar 24->20px,
  activity bar 48->40px, plus tighter tree rows and chat messages
- the label 'Rapat' (which means meeting) is now 'Padat' across 10 languages

OTHER
- bg_image: SVG, AVIF, ICO support (SVG detected from XML content, not extension)
- harness uji-t7-performa.mjs (10/10) plus Rust bg_image tests (3 pass)
- release notes updated

zephyr: Zeph menjawab identitas model da.subject: fix(ai): Zeph answers model identity from fact, not from guesswork
zephyr: Zeph menjawab identitas model da.body:
PROBLEM: asked 'what model are you', Zeph answered 'I am Claude by Anthropic',
inventing from training bias, then contradicted the model that was actually
configured. A model has no way to read its own metadata, so without a fact
supplied by Zephyr the answer is always a guess.

- systemPrompt: a 'Model running you' block carries the model name and the
  provider ACTUALLY sent to the API, plus a rule against claiming another model
- identityReminder(model): the model name also goes at the very end of the
  history, where models follow instructions most closely
- aiStore: model and provider are passed into systemPromptFor (chat and agent)
- PromptSection: a read-only 'Model running the AI' panel (if it were editable,
  a user could make the AI claim a different model)
- harness uji-t6-identitas.mjs: 8/8, including a real model reply
- i18n: 4 keys x 10 languages (581 keys)

zephyr: perbaiki jalur verifikasi (mock.subject: fix(verify): mock v5 and settings restore, plus test leftover cleanup
zephyr: perbaiki jalur verifikasi (mock.body:
- verify09.mjs and verify-skill-memory.mjs demanded an older mock (v4/v3)
  while the mock had been v5 since Gemini history and agent tool-call support,
  so both harnesses failed at step V0 before testing anything
- verify-skill-memory.mjs never called cdp.close(), so the settings snapshot
  was never restored: the user's app was left pointing at a dead mock on
  127.0.0.1:8098. close() is now called before exit
- work report for 23 Sep written to a Google Doc

zephyr: perbaiki API key provider + posi.subject: fix: API key provider selection and sidebar position from Customize Layout
zephyr: perbaiki API key provider + posi.body:
- init() now picks a provider that HAS a key instead of always gemini; if the
  active provider is empty while the user has filled a key elsewhere, the app
  switches automatically and explains why (before, the user was told to fill a
  key for a provider they were not using)
- Customize Layout: the Left/Right buttons now write to settings.sidebar, which
  the renderer reads; before they only touched internal state, so the click
  changed nothing
- App.tsx: sidebar position falls back to 'left' so the sidebar no longer
  disappears when settings.json has no sidebar key
- donate icon: emoji replaced with SVG (antislop-ui bans decorative emoji)
- README: dropped the removed features (Test Explorer, SFTP), added theme and
  background screenshots, removed 6 outdated feature screenshots

zephyr: v1.1.10 — panel AI kanan + fulls.subject: feat: v1.1.10 with right-column AI panel, standalone subagents, 19 themes, custom background
zephyr: v1.1.10 — panel AI kanan + fulls.body:
AI panel:
- can move to the right column WITHOUT opening the bottom panel (the terminal
  does not follow along)
- the right column can be resized by dragging and maximized VS Code style
- the AI tab leaves the bottom strip while the chat sits on the right; the
  subagent info panel can sit beside the chat

Subagents:
- moved to their own tab, started purely by the user (the AI cannot call them)
- 6 roles with badges; only 'kerja' may write files
- a model picker per batch

Model picker:
- two levels (provider -> model), providers without an API key are hidden,
  with a search box

Themes and background:
- 10 new themes (Dracula, Catppuccin, Rose Pine, Kanagawa, Everforest, GitHub
  Dark, Ayu Mirage, Solarized Light, Nord Light, Min Light) for 19 total
- custom background: set a photo, Samar/Sedang/Jelas presets, a slider, a fit
  mode, a translucent panel toggle; stored SEPARATELY from the theme
- bg_image_read in Rust reads the image into a data URL (type from magic bytes)

About:
- reworked to be brief: an identity card, a build card, and one row of buttons
  (check update, GitHub, report an issue, WhatsApp group, support)

Bug fixes:
- reset_settings no longer removes the sidebar (the Rust defaults were missing
  sidebar/layout/subagent/general.aiPanel)
- the gear icon opens Settings again (activity stayed stuck on 'settings')
- shortcut remaps from Settings actually apply (settings.shortcuts vs
  keybindings.json are now one source)
- CSS for the maximized AI panel added (the is-max class had no rule)
- the Ctrl+Shift+O collision is gone; the Language Server section has a title
- the command palette is clean: 114 commands, 0 duplicates

Removed: Dev Environment, API client, SQLite browser, Cloudflare Tunnel.

zephyr: Customize Layout + panel AI bisa.subject: feat: Customize Layout panel and a hideable AI panel, VS Code style
zephyr: Customize Layout + panel AI bisa.body:
From the user's VS Code screenshot: one panel for EVERY layout control, and an
AI panel that can be closed from inside itself.

T3.5 Customize Layout (19/19 pass):
- a floating panel in the title bar (View: Customize Layout) with toggles for
  Menu Bar / Activity Bar / Primary Side Bar / Panel / Status Bar,
  sidebar position (left/right), density (normal/compact), Zen Mode
- each row shows its current state (eye icon) plus its shortcut
- a reset button returns everything to default
- choices are SAVED to settings, so the layout survives a restart
- 6 new palette commands: view.customizeLayout, view.toggleMenuBar,
  view.toggleActivityBar, view.toggleStatusBar, view.toggleLayoutCompact,
  view.hideAiPanel

AI panel:
- an X button in the panel header (ai-hide) closes it from inside, the way the
  VS Code chat panel does. In the right column it returns to the bottom dock.

Evidence (real tests, not just state):
- toggles checked from the DOM: the element is really gone (React unmounts it)
- sidebar position: the app-body class changes sidebar-pos-left -> right
- density: the is-compact class appears and disappears
- persistence: statusBar=false survives a reload
- 3 new screenshots: 14-customize-layout, 15-panel-ai-hide, 16-layout-compact
